facts.fact: ANDF's PPMEC II project chief said the e-Foncier Bénin platform has functions to register parcels, issue cadastral registration certificates and update records, with 643,993 parcels registered in 12 communes.
ANDF's PPMEC II project chief reported 643,993 parcels registered in the cadastral database across 12 communes, 3 fully covered and 9 partly, with e-Foncier Bénin in use.

BEN.note: The document says nothing on local government office connections.
